gen-gf-bpmf-huninn-fs-literata: Modern and a touch bookish, Bpmf Huninn draws round, wide-mouthed letters with a pencil that never presses harder. And Literata, a classic serif, lets its thin and thick strokes differ only slightly, so paragraphs flow without any jolt.
gen-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std-fs-literata: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std is approachable, with apertures that stay open even at tiny sizes and weight that shifts only slightly. Literata does the opposite job, its sturdy thin and thick strokes giving a serif body a bookish, sophisticated feel.
gen-gf-brawler-fs-bespoke-sans: Sharp and refined, Bespoke Sans leaves generous space between its curve ends and stems, with almost no variation in stroke. Brawler brings editorial thick-and-thin strokes above it, so the page gets a literary headline and a crisp text.
gen-gf-brygada-1918-fs-bespoke-sans: Classic and editorial, Brygada 1918 shifts mildly from heavy stems to lighter curves, its mouths staying open. Bespoke Sans stays low in contrast, with generous gaps by the stems, so extended text stays crisp.
gen-gf-buenard-fs-bespoke-sans: Buenard carries a traditional look, its curves swelling gently and its thick and thin strokes differing modestly but noticeably. Bespoke Sans below is sharper, with generous space around its curves.
gen-gf-bytesized-fs-literata: Literata reads as a sophisticated, bookish classic serif, with sturdy thin lines and only a faint difference between upstrokes and downstrokes. Bytesized sits above it like bent steel rod, one flat line weight running through every glyph.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-bitter: Stout, wiry, a little rough: Cabin Sketch draws each stroke like a pipe cleaner, in tall little letters. Bitter, a slab-serif, answers with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap in every s.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-inter: Cabin Sketch is bold and distinctive, each stroke as stout as a drawn pipe cleaner. Inter follows in sans-serif, its smooth, tube-like lines and big counters giving the text room to breathe.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-mulish: Wiry and loud, Cabin Sketch pulls the eye with stout, pipe-cleaner strokes and tall little letters. But Mulish, a sans, has no thick-thin modulation at all, just open apertures and a large x-height for the text.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-poppins: Poppins takes the text, with rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends and a tall, sturdy lowercase, against the wiry Cabin Sketch. Give that sans a comfortable size, since its body is tall already.
